---
description: Route ambiguity to its authoritative lifecycle layer.
agent: agent
---

Invoke `open-question-handling` and select exactly one mode.

## Record mode

Use this mode when `--resolve` is absent. Identify whether the ambiguity belongs
to a requirement, `spec.md`, `plan.md`, or `DEV-####.md`. Record a
decision-ready question with 2-3 concrete options, build implications, owner,
and blocking effect. Do not close it until a named human decision is recorded
in the authoritative artifact.

## Resolve mode

Use this mode only when the invocation contains `--resolve`. Require one
explicit lifecycle issue reference, either an issue number such as `#6` or the
issue URL. If it is missing, stop immediately and ask the current persona for
the issue number. Do not search for, infer, or select an issue.

Resolve the issue's authoritative artifacts and collect all unchecked open
questions. Present exactly one question at a time with its existing options and
implications. Always add a final choice named `Provide a different decision`;
never present only the authored options. Wait for an explicit human choice
before editing. Do not combine questions, recommend an unstated option, infer a
decision, or close a question from contextual hints.

If the human selects `Provide a different decision`, ask a free-text follow-up
for their proposed decision. Explain its build implication, then ask the human
to confirm the exact final wording before recording it. Do not silently map the
free-text decision to an existing option or require the human to choose one of
the authored options.

For each explicit decision, ask for the decider's name if it is not already
known from the current authenticated user, and record the current ISO date.
Mark the authoritative question as:

`- [x] <question and selected decision> -- decided by <name> <yyyy-mm-dd>`

Update affected requirement text only when the human decision explicitly
changes it; preserve provenance and do not invent supporting evidence. Continue
one question at a time until no unchecked questions remain or the human stops.
Then report resolved and remaining counts and rerun the validator appropriate
to the owning lifecycle layer. Never advance status, approve a gate, commit,
push, or open/merge a pull request.
